newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: U.S. wheat major net sales activity in the week ended Oct 10 reported by exporters for the following purchasing countries, in tonnes:
Net sales of 737,000 tonnes were more than double the previous week and 75 percent above the four-week average.
Exports of 561,800 tonnes were 19 percent below the week earlier, and 26 percent lower than the four-week average.
Primary Export Destinations: Egypt (105,000), Sri Lanka (52,500), Taiwan (45,600), South Africa (45,100), Italy (41,800), and Japan (41,200).
